Diego —

Thanks for the ping. Quick summary / recommended path:
- Additional Insured: We can add EdgeWave as Additional Insured on the Commercial General Liability (and auto) via an ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent) endorsement. Need broker coordination; attached a proposed endorsement clause and a redline to their Order Form (MSA_Redline_20260210.docx + PDF redline).
- Waiver of Subrogation: acceptable for CG only; we should resist a broad waiver that includes E&O/cyber because that shifts insurer recovery risk. Recommend limiting waiver to CG and only to the extent permitted by law and carrier.
- E&O / Cyber Limits: We currently carry Technology E&O $2M per claim / $3M aggregate and Cyber $2M. $5M is above our standard. Options: (1) agree to $3M aggregate and provide a contractual risk transfer (cap on liability in the MSA), (2) agree to $5M but require surcharge/price change, or (3) provide written confirmation of intent to procure higher limits within X days with proof of binder — not ideal.

Proposed markup highlights (in attached redline):
- Strike absolute AI + waiver language; replace with "Redwood will provide Additional Insured endorsements for the General Liability policy only, to the extent commercially available from Redwood's insurers."
- Add requirement for insurers to have AM Best rating of A- or better (or equivalent).
- Add a 60‑day cure / notice for any lapses / non-renewals.

Attachments: MSA_Redline_20260210.docx (track changes), EdgeWave_OrderForm_v2_redline.pdf (visual redline).

cc: Broker — please confirm whether our carrier can issue CG AI endorsements and whether a Waiver of Subrogation can be issued for CG. Also please provide an updated COI showing current limits.
